decisions.statement: The properties a page must have are read from its page type and the types above that page type.
A page type restating an inherited property narrows that property.
A property its type declares uncommitted is not demanded of the page.
Such a value stands in a file beside the page rather than in the page.
A page stating a property its type declares uncommitted is refused.
A property its type declares secret is not demanded of the page.
Such a value stands in the page's sops file rather than in the page.
A page stating a property its type declares secret is refused.
A property its type fixes a value for is not demanded of the page.
Every page of that type has that value without stating that value.
A page stating a property its type fixes is refused.
A property its type works out is not demanded of the page.
Such a value is worked out as the page is read rather than kept in the page.
A page stating a property its type works out is refused.
The words that refusal prints are read from the refusal's own page.
A page type the change has is read as the change leaves that page type.
Where a page type sits is read from the index as the change leaves that page type.
A page type the index does not name is passed over rather than throwing.
A change with an entry file alone is an input to this check.
An entry file is judged as the page that entry file sits beside.
A page a change reaches by its own file and by an entry file is judged once.
A page whose page type declares nothing is passed over.
A text property stating a name format has every value judged by that format's own code.
A count on a declaration counts entries and a length counts characters.
A declaration's length narrows the length its property states.
A name format is reached through the index and loaded off the disk.
A page whose body will not load is passed over rather than refused.
A page stating no page type is refused.
A property a generator fills is not required of a page being created.
A property a generator fills is required of every page that already exists.
A page is being created when the base commit has no body for its path.
Whether a page is being created is read from the change and not from the disk.
Which properties a generator fills is read from the module owning that answer.
A page stating a group has that group's members judged as the group declares.
A value whose property declares fields and is no record refuses the page.
A property whose page type is under `page-property-entry` states its file's extension.
No other sort a value has is judged here.
A row leaving out a field its shape requires is refused, as a page leaving one out is.
Every field of a record nested in an entry row is judged against what declares that record.
A record nested in a record is opened as deep as the value goes.
A value whose property names members is judged against the members it names.
A record there is judged against the one member declaring fields.
A record among several members declaring fields is judged against the one whose fields it fits.
A record fitting no one of those members refuses the page.
A value a member declaring no field admits refuses nothing.

definition: the check refusing a page that does not carry what its page type declares
